description: Ken Lundy, a Program Manager at UCF Launch, shares his personal experience during a significant historical event as part of the Knight's Tales Project. Lundy recounts his time working for Steelcase and being in the vicinity of the World Trade Center during a major incident. He describes the communication challenges he faced while trying to contact his spouse amidst the chaos. Lundy reflects on the psychological trauma experienced by many and emphasizes the importance of remembrance and healing for the victims. His narrative provides insight into the immediate aftermath of the event and the broader social impacts. This account contributes to the collective memory of the event, highlighting the personal and professional challenges faced by individuals during crises.
